title: Set 53

sentences.ko: 보내기 전에 한번 봐 달라고 해서 처음부터 끝까지 다 읽고 의견까지 적어서 답을 보내요. 그런데 결국 자기 방식대로 해 버려요. 이쯤 되면 내가 왜 이걸 하고 있나 싶어요. 게다가 사람이 착해요. 그게 제일 걸리는 부분이라 대놓고 투덜대지도 못해요.
sentences.text: She asks me to look at something before she sends it, so I actually read the whole thing and write her back, and then she just does it her way anyway. At this point I don't know why I even bother. And she's nice, that's the part that gets me, so I can't even complain about it out loud.

alts.text: So she'll send me stuff to look over before it goes out, and I read the whole thing and write back with notes, and then she just does it her way anyway. Honestly I don't know why I bother anymore. And she's nice, that's the part that gets me, so I can't even gripe about it out loud.

She asks me to review something before she sends it, so I read it in full and write back with my thoughts, and then she does it her own way regardless. At this point I am not sure why I make the effort. And she is kind, which is the part that gets to me, so I cannot even voice a complaint.

sentences.note: **that's the part that gets me** 는 여러 가지 중에 유독 마음에 걸리는 지점을 콕 짚을 때 씁니다. **complain about it out loud** 는 속으로만 삭이지 않고 입 밖으로 불평한다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 회사 사람 때문에 짜증난 걸 친구한테 털어놓기

sentences.ko: 로봇 청소기를 하나 샀는데 되긴 돼요. 근데 돌리기 전에 바닥에 있는 걸 다 치워야 해서, 결국 청소기가 청소하라고 제가 청소를 하는 셈이에요. 그동안 룸메이트는 일반 청소기를 꺼내 와서 십 분이면 끝내요. 후회한다는 건 아닌데, 다시 사지는 않을 것 같아요.
sentences.text: I got one of those robot vacuums, and it works, but I have to pick everything up off the floor before I run it, so I'm basically cleaning so the thing can clean. Meanwhile my roommate drags out the regular vacuum and he's done in ten minutes. I'm not saying I regret it, but I probably wouldn't buy it again.

alts.text: Bought one of those robot vacuums. It works, but I've gotta pick everything up off the floor before I run it, so I'm basically cleaning so it can clean. Meanwhile my roommate hauls out the regular vacuum and he's done in ten minutes. I'm not saying I regret it, but I probably wouldn't get another one.

I purchased one of those robotic vacuums, and it does work, but I have to clear everything off the floor before running it, so I am essentially cleaning so that it can clean. Meanwhile my roommate brings out the regular vacuum and finishes in ten minutes. I would not say I regret the purchase, but I probably would not buy it again.

sentences.note: **I'm basically cleaning so the thing can clean** 의 basically 는 따지고 보면 결국 이렇게 되는 거라고 상황을 정리할 때 붙입니다. **I'm not saying I regret it, but** 은 아니라고 먼저 못 박고 반대되는 속마음을 꺼내는 말투입니다.

sentences.ko: 토요일에 헬스장에서 그런 수업을 하나 들었는데 그날 밤에는 멀쩡했어요. 그게 함정이에요. 다음 날이 돼야 오거든요. 오늘 아침에는 남의 집 할머니처럼 난간을 붙잡고 계단을 옆으로 내려왔어요. 강사가 오랜만에 나왔으니 무리하지 말라고 했었거든요! 듣긴 들었죠. 저 혼자 앉아 있는 사람이 되기가 싫었을 뿐이에요.
sentences.text: I did one of those classes at the gym Saturday and I felt fine that night, which is how it gets you, because it doesn't hit you till the day after. I had to go down the stairs sideways this morning holding the rail like somebody's grandmother. And the instructor told me to take it easy my first time back! I heard her, I just wasn't going to be the one sitting down.

alts.text: Took one of those classes at the gym Saturday and I felt totally fine that night, which is how it gets you, cause it doesn't hit till the day after. This morning I had to go down the stairs sideways holding the rail like somebody's grandma. And the instructor told me to take it easy my first time back! I heard her, I just wasn't gonna be the one sitting down.

I attended one of those classes at the gym on Saturday and felt perfectly fine that evening, which is exactly how it catches you, because it does not affect you until the following day. This morning I had to go down the stairs sideways, holding the rail like someone's grandmother. And the instructor did tell me to take it easy on my first time back! I heard her. I simply was not going to be the one who sat down.

sentences.note: **take it easy** 는 무리하지 말고 살살 하라는 뜻입니다. **it doesn't hit you till the day after** 처럼 hit 는 근육통이나 피로가 뒤늦게 몰려온다고 할 때 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 그 드라마 두 시즌까지는 정말 좋아해서 만나는 사람마다 보라고 했어요. 그러다 출연진을 절반이나 갈아치웠고, 지금은 사람들이 서서 서로한테 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 설명만 하고 있어요. 그래도 아직 보고 있어요. 저도 우습다는 거 알아요. 그냥 남들한테 보라는 말만 안 하게 됐어요.
sentences.text: I loved that show for the first two seasons and I told everybody to watch it, but then they swapped out half the cast and now it's just people standing around explaining what's happening to each other. I'm still watching it, which I know is ridiculous. I've just stopped telling people to start it.

alts.text: First two seasons of that show I was obsessed, told everybody to watch it, and then they swapped out half the cast and now it's just people standing around explaining what's going on to each other. I'm still watching it, which I know is ridiculous. I've just quit telling people to start it.

I greatly enjoyed that show for its first two seasons and recommended it to everyone, but then they replaced half of the cast, and now it is simply people standing around explaining what is happening to one another. I am still watching it, which I recognize is absurd. I have simply stopped telling people to start it.

sentences.note: **swapped out half the cast** 는 출연진 절반을 다른 배우로 갈아치웠다는 말입니다. **which I know is ridiculous** 는 자기 행동이 어이없다는 걸 스스로 인정하면서 덧붙이는 표현입니다.

sentences.ko: 좋아요, 물어봤으니까 말하는데 색은 진짜 잘 어울려요. 제가 걸리는 건 핏이에요. 어깨가 좀 내려와 있어서 자꾸 잡아당기게 되는 거예요. 한 치수 작은 것도 있어요? 태그 떼기 전에 그거 한번 입어 보는 게 좋겠어요.
sentences.text: Okay, you asked, so, the color is great on you. It's the fit I'd think about, because the shoulders are sitting kind of low and that's why you keep pulling at it. Do they have it a size down? Because I'd go try that on before you take the tags off.

alts.text: Since you're asking, the color looks amazing on you. It's the fit I'd think about, cause the shoulders are sitting kinda low and that's why you keep tugging at it. Do they have it a size down? I'd go try that on before you pull the tags off.

Since you have asked, the color suits you very well. It is the fit that I would consider, because the shoulders are sitting somewhat low, and that is why you keep pulling at it. Do they have it in one size smaller? I would try that on before you remove the tags.

sentences.note: **a size down** 은 한 치수 작은 것을 말합니다. **before you take the tags off** 는 아직 태그가 붙어 있어 되돌릴 수 있는 상태, 즉 결정하기 전이라는 뜻으로 자주 씁니다.
sentences.situation: 친구가 산 옷 어떠냐고 물었을 때 솔직하게 말하기

reviewed: 첫 문장 note 가 text 에 없는 gripe 를 가르치고 있었습니다(캐주얼에만 나옴). 연습하는 문장에 실제로 있는 complain about it out loud 를 짚도록 바꿨습니다.
첫 문장 formal 의 she proceeds her own way 는 문법이 어긋난 말이라 she does it her own way regardless 로 고쳤습니다.
첫 문장 formal 의 troubles me 는 걸린다는 원래 뜻을 눅여서 gets to me 로 되돌렸습니다(말투만 올리고 내용은 그대로).
두 번째 formal 의 ordinary vacuum 은 원어민이 그 자리에서 안 쓰는 말입니다. 격식체에서도 regular vacuum 이라고 합니다.
네 번째 formal 의 merely stopped telling people to begin it 이 어색해서 simply stopped telling people to start it 으로 고쳤습니다(begin it 은 드라마를 보기 시작한다는 뜻으로 안 씁니다).
